items.quote: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
items.claim: Abimelech questioned Abraham about an action Abraham had taken

items.quote: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place
items.claim: Abraham stated his belief that the fear of God was absent from that location

items.quote: and they will slay me for my wife's sake
items.claim: Abraham feared unnamed persons would kill him on account of his wife
